news.headline: Central Florida Wed Nov 25: NWS Melbourne Flood Watch Wed 1 AM through Thu 1 AM and Coastal Flood Advisory Wed 5 AM through Thu 11 AM in effect, with a River Flood Warning and Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM — Melbourne Wed morning light rain 69°F, high near 71°F / low 62°F, rain chance 100% with about 0.57 in expected

Florida housing Oct 2026 — Florida Realtors Nov 16: existing single-family closed sales fell 10.1% year over year to 19,049, the third straight monthly decline, while the statewide median rose 2.2% to $420,000; condo-townhouse sales fell 5% to 6,862 with median down 3.3% to $290,000, and new pending single-family sales dropped 15.7%

South Florida new homes Nov 2026 — Momentum tracker checked Nov 23 lists 14 Broward County communities, 10 selling, with Pulte's Coral Edge townhomes in Margate now from $510,990, down from $584,990 in October, and Toll Brothers' Hanson Preserve in Cooper City from $1,304,995

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper falls Tue Nov 24 — Morningstar / Dow Jones at 1:53 PM ET: front-month COMEX copper settled 4.70% lower at $5.3625/lb; ScrapMonster Nov 25 reported North American copper scrap fell 25 cents/lb on Nov 24 for #1 Bare Bright, #1 and #2 Wire and Tubing, and #3 Light Copper

HVAC manufacturers report increased Q3 revenue — ACHR News Nov 23: Carrier, Trane Technologies and Lennox posted improved residential and commercial revenue, data centers are driving commercial demand with Johnson Controls reporting record backlogs, and contractors face continued price increases from tariffs and high fuel prices

Wall Street closes mixed Tue Nov 24 — Dow Jones rose 423.39 points (0.85%) to close above 50,000 at 50,018.70 on a rotation into value, while the S&P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.48% to 23,733.54 as the AI rally fizzled

Mortgage rates and the Fed — Bankrate Nov 24 put the average 30-year fixed at 7.33%, with 56% of polled experts expecting rates to drop in the week of Nov 25–Dec 2; October PCE inflation is due Wed Nov 25, and futures price about a 95% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting, lifting the target from 3.75%-4.00% to 4.00%-4.25%

NBA Tue Nov 24 — Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86 in NBA Cup play at Kia Center, Isaiah Joe scoring 21 points as Orlando (7-10) took its first NBA Cup loss; Miami Heat (10-6), on a seven-game win streak, visit the Philadelphia 76ers Wed Nov 25 at 5 PM ET in NBA Cup play, with Giannis Antetokounmpo questionable (groin)

NFL — all three Florida teams lost Sun Nov 22: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; Week ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM
